text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when buffeted by natural disasters 
and waves of information, Transcend stood 
tall once more. And so, she achieved 
back-to-back victories in the Champions 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her run touched the hearts of countless 
people. Reading the influx of messages 
from all across the nation, Transcend 
couldn't help but feel a thrill run down 
her spine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is something that Transcend can only 
appreciate now, having overcome so much 
pain and sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend previously compared life to a 
dull, "mediocre cinema that's neither good 
nor bad." However, that's not how she sees 
it now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“As long as you get back up when you fall 
and keep moving forward in search of 
something, life is a thrilling cinematic 
blockbuster.” Transcend concluded with a 
smile.
